options.content:
## My Copilot Activity and Usage

This is a self-service dashboard showing your individual GitHub Copilot activity. Select your GitHub username from the filter at the top of the page. Data has a 2-day lag — today's view reflects activity up to 2 days ago.

**Two data sources**

| Section | Source | Lag | What it shows |
|---|---|---|---|
| Summary stats, trends, model and feature breakdown | GitHub API via exporter, VictoriaMetrics | 2 days | Authoritative daily aggregates keyed to your GitHub username |
| AI credit log, feature log | Loki structured daily records | 2 days | Per-day structured log with all fields available for filtering |

**How to use**
1. Select your GitHub username from the username dropdown above.
2. Set your monthly AI credit budget in the budget field if your team has an allocation.
3. Use the time picker to change the window between today, this week, this month, or a custom range.
4. The budget gauge shows credits used this month against your entered budget.

**Important:** AI credits are the premium model billing metric. 1 AI Credit = $0.01 USD. Standard model usage does not consume AI credits and will show 0 on the credit panels.

panels.title: Active Days
panels.description: Number of days you used at least one Copilot feature in the selected window. Source: github_copilot_user_daily_record count of data points for your username.

panels.title: Total Prompts
panels.description: Total number of Copilot prompts and interactions you triggered across all surfaces in the selected window. Source: github_copilot_user_prompt_count.

panels.title: Lines of Code Added
panels.description: Total lines of AI-generated code you accepted into your codebase in the selected window. This is the primary output productivity signal. Source: github_copilot_user_loc_added_sum.

panels.title: AI Credits Used
panels.description: Total AI credits consumed in the selected window. AI credits apply to premium model requests only. 1 AI Credit = $0.01 USD. Standard model usage does not consume credits. Source: github_copilot_user_ai_credits_used.

panels.title: My Adoption Phase
panels.description: Your current AI adoption phase as assigned by GitHub based on your recent usage pattern. Explorer means no usage yet. Developer means active on at least one feature. Power User means sustained multi-feature engagement. Source: github_copilot_user_ai_adoption_phase.

panels.title: Monthly AI Credit Budget Used
panels.description: AI credits consumed this month as a percentage of your entered monthly budget. Set the budget using the field at the top of the dashboard. Green means within budget, amber means approaching limit, red means over 90% consumed.

panels.title: My Daily Prompt Count
panels.description: Number of Copilot prompts you submitted each day in the selected window. Gaps indicate days with no Copilot usage. Spikes typically correspond to heavy feature development or debugging sessions. Source: github_copilot_user_prompt_count.

panels.title: My Daily AI Credits Used
panels.description: AI credits you consumed each day. Credits apply to premium model usage only. Days showing zero may indicate standard model usage rather than no activity. Source: github_copilot_user_ai_credits_used.

panels.title: My Weekly Prompts
panels.description: Total prompts per week across the selected window. Use this to identify high-usage weeks and understand which projects or tasks drove the most Copilot activity. Source: github_copilot_user_prompt_count aggregated weekly.

panels.title: My Weekly LOC Added
panels.description: Total lines of AI-generated code accepted per week. Combine with weekly prompts to calculate LOC per prompt — a rising ratio means each prompt is generating more usable code. Source: github_copilot_user_loc_added_sum aggregated weekly.

panels.title: My Weekly AI Credits
panels.description: Total AI credits consumed per week. Useful for tracking spend trends against billing cycles and identifying unusually expensive weeks. Source: github_copilot_user_ai_credits_used aggregated weekly.

panels.title: My Prompts by Model
panels.description: Distribution of prompts across models in the selected window. If premium models dominate for tasks that do not require them, switching to standard models would reduce AI credit consumption. Source: github_copilot_user_model_feature_prompt_count grouped by model.

panels.title: My Prompts by Feature
panels.description: Distribution of prompts across Copilot features (completions, chat, code review, CLI, etc.). Shows how you use Copilot across different surfaces. Source: github_copilot_user_feature_prompt_count grouped by feature.

panels.title: My Top Languages by LOC Added
panels.description: Programming languages where you accepted the most AI-generated code. Reflects where you are getting the highest output value from Copilot. Source: github_copilot_user_language_feature_loc_added_sum grouped by language.

panels.title: My LOC Added vs LOC Suggested
panels.description: Daily comparison of lines of code suggested by Copilot against lines you actually accepted. The gap between the two lines shows how selective you are with suggestions. A narrowing gap means you are accepting more of what Copilot offers. Source: github_copilot_user_loc_suggested_to_add_sum and github_copilot_user_loc_added_sum.

panels.title: My Code Acceptance Rate Over Time
panels.description: Daily ratio of code acceptance activities to code generation activities. A rising trend means you are accepting a higher proportion of AI suggestions over time. Source: github_copilot_user_code_acceptance_activity_count divided by github_copilot_user_code_generation_activity_count.

panels.title: My Daily Activity Log
panels.description: Structured daily log records for your user from Loki. Each row represents one day of your Copilot activity. Expand a row to see all parsed fields including ai_credits_used, prompt_count, loc_added_sum, totals_by_model_feature, totals_by_feature, CLI token usage, and adoption phase. Source: Loki copilot_exporter stream filtered to your username.

panels.title: My Prompts by IDE
panels.description: Breakdown of your Copilot prompts by IDE over the selected window. Useful for understanding which development environment you use most with Copilot. Source: github_copilot_user_ide_prompt_count grouped by ide.

panels.title: My LOC Added by IDE
panels.description: Lines of AI-generated code accepted per IDE. If you use multiple IDEs, this shows where Copilot is delivering the most code output for you. Source: github_copilot_user_ide_loc_added_sum grouped by ide.
